fusions.name: Dig the Barb Out
fusions.desc: A gouging thrust that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Snare Ditch
fusions.desc: Digs a 6-tile ditch lined with barbs ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flukes Set Fast
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaff-Backed Blade
fusions.desc: Conjures a digging blade with a gaff on its back. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
